# secobserve_product_rule (List Resource)

Lists the rules of one SecObserve product.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Emits import blocks and configuration for the rules of one product.
list "secobserve_product_rule" "all" {
  provider = secobserve

  config {
    # A .tfquery.hcl cannot reference resources; use the product id.
    product = 12
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `product` (Number) Id of the product whose objects to list.
